verdict.rationale: Exa is an API-first product (exa-js SDK, REST endpoints, webhooks, streaming) that is naturally callable headlessly from scripts/CI without any UI, and supports async batch operations like Websets and deep research suited to automation pipelines. missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD example (e.g., GitHub Actions), no dedicated 'headless/automation' documentation section, and no independent report confirming CI usage.
